summary: Review online sales contracts, consumer issues, data flows and tax questions. Build practical market-entry records with this five-day course.
lede: Cross-border e-commerce legal training helps e-commerce counsel, compliance professionals and international sales managers identify legal questions in online transactions. It covers mapping transaction parties and order flows, reviewing digital sales terms and CISG scope for relevant business-to-business sales, and tracing consumer complaint routes and customer data handoffs. Participants use an ISO 31000-informed risk register to record market-entry, fulfilment and digital-tax issues for review or escalation.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who review, operate or support online sales across borders and need a repeatable way to identify legal questions before launch or escalation.
modules: OECD Privacy Guidelines and Data Flows
prerequisites: Prior experience with e-commerce operations, commercial contracting, compliance or legal review is recommended. Coding or programming is not required. You should be ready to assess transaction examples and distinguish general issue-spotting from advice that requires qualified local counsel.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
